seoTitle: Connect Facebook to Your GoDaddy Website
metaDescription: Link your Facebook page or Messenger chat to your GoDaddy website using the built-in site builder tools, on both desktop and mobile.
intro: Connecting Facebook to your GoDaddy website lets you display a feed, link your page, or add Messenger chat, giving visitors more ways to engage with your business. This guide covers linking Facebook using GoDaddy's built-in site builder tools on both desktop and mobile.

steps.heading: Open your GoDaddy website builder
steps.body: Log in to your GoDaddy account and open the site builder for the website you want to connect Facebook to.

steps.heading: Add a social media section
steps.body: Find the section for adding social media links or feeds and select Facebook as the platform to connect.

steps.heading: Connect your Facebook business page
steps.body: Authorize the connection between your Facebook business page and your GoDaddy website so content can sync properly.

steps.heading: Add Messenger chat if desired
steps.body: If you want live chat functionality, enable the Messenger integration so visitors can message your page directly from the site.

steps.heading: Verify the sync on desktop and mobile
steps.body: Check that the Facebook integration displays and functions correctly across both desktop and mobile views of your site.

faq.question: Can I connect a personal Facebook profile instead of a page?
faq.answer: This integration is designed for business pages rather than personal profiles, so a Facebook page is the expected connection point.

faq.question: Does connecting Facebook slow down my website?
faq.answer: A properly configured feed shouldn't noticeably affect load times, though it's worth testing your site's performance after adding it.

faq.question: Can I add Messenger chat without a full Facebook feed?
faq.answer: Yes, Messenger chat can typically be added independently of displaying a full Facebook feed on your site.

faq.question: Will this method work the same on mobile devices?
faq.answer: Yes, the guide covers both desktop and mobile methods, so the connection process works whichever device you're using.
